overview: The Medford City Council met to congratulate the municipal election workers and candidates, confirm appointments to the housing authority, discuss a proposed Salem Street Corridor rezoning map amendment, and vote to override the Mayor's veto of the Values Aligned Local Investments Ordinance.

items.title: 2025 Municipal Election Resolution
items.summary: The Council approved a resolution congratulating the Medford Elections Commission and all candidates in the 2025 municipal election.

items.title: Meeting Records and Executive Session Minutes
items.summary: The Council approved the minutes from the October 28, 2025 meeting and acknowledged the continued non-disclosure of executive session minutes from August 19, 2025.

items.title: Medford Housing Authority Appointment of Lawrence Nargi
items.summary: The Council approved the appointment of Lawrence Nargi to the Medford Housing Authority after briefly tabling the item due to initial technical difficulties.

items.title: Medford Housing Authority Appointment of Losa Julie Childs
items.summary: The Council approved the appointment of Losa Julie Childs to the Medford Housing Authority.

items.title: Salem Street Corridor Rezoning Map Change Public Hearing
items.summary: The Council held a public hearing on a proposed zoning map amendment to change the Salem Street and Park Street node from MX-2 to MX-1, ultimately voting to continue the hearing to the next regular meeting.

items.title: Values Aligned Local Investments Ordinance Veto Override
items.summary: The Council voted to override the Mayor's October 9th veto of the amended Values Aligned Local Investments Ordinance.

items.title: Public Participation
items.summary: Residents spoke on local issues including local ICE activity and Veterans Day, after which the meeting was adjourned.
